title: Order extra tags for an E-Toll Account
summary: Existing E-Toll Account holders can order extra tags or brackets online.
intro: If you have an existing Transport for NSW (TfNSW) E-Toll Tag Account, you can order extra tags or brackets online.
who_can_apply: Must be the account holder or an authorised contact person.

how_to_steps.text: Select the number of tags or brackets you want.

more_info.text: It's important that you fit your tag correctly to avoid the toll road operator fees that apply if your tag is not detected when you're using a toll road.
If you apply or replace a tag at a Service NSW Centre, you will not get a physical tag over the counter. Your tag will be posted to your nominated address within 5-7 business days.

You can use toll roads immediately following successful payment, provided you list a valid licence plate number on your account. Any vehicle matching fees incurred during this time will be re-credited to your E-Toll Tag Account and appear on your next statement cycle.

external_links.text: Types of e-toll tags and how to install them

faqs.a: You must be the account holder or an authorised contact person.
Payment methods include credit cards (Mastercard, Visa, American Express), debit cards (Mastercard, Visa), or direct debit from a bank account.

faqs.q: How do I order extra tags online?
faqs.a: Select 'Order online', log in to your account, select 'Tags', choose 'Add TAG/material', select the desired number of tags or brackets, and submit your request.
